sprints.title: Data Services 10 JUN 26
sprints.goals: This sprint aimed to advance multiple applications toward production readiness by establishing foundational infrastructure for test environments, resolving critical operational issues across distributed sites, and delivering user-facing enhancements that improve workflow efficiency and reporting capabilities.
sprints.summary: The team successfully deployed infrastructure across four major applications, creating required lists and libraries for Access Requests, AMIT, SALT, and Compliance Review in test and production environments while pushing three applications to production. Critical bugs affecting attribute synchronization across sites, supervisor selection accuracy, and PDF generation were resolved, and significant user experience improvements were implemented including dynamic task filtering, approver visibility into their approved requests, and enhanced administrative controls. These completions establish stable test environments for ongoing development, eliminate blocking production issues, and deliver tangible improvements to end-user workflows across the platform.

sprints.title: Data Services 24 JUN 27
sprints.goals: This sprint aimed to expand functionality across multiple modules including travel coordinator workflows in Access Requests, records management capabilities in Compliance Review, and software licensing approvals in SALT, while simultaneously preparing systems for production deployment and resolving critical blocking issues preventing normal operations.
sprints.summary: The team completed 43 issues spanning four product areas, delivering substantial enhancements to user workflows and system stability. Key accomplishments include implementing travel coordinator role-based access and filtering in Access Requests, establishing Compliance Review's production infrastructure with proper menu configuration and records mapping, resolving critical SALT approval and data persistence bugs that were blocking user operations, and introducing new UI patterns such as read-only note viewing and improved form validation across the platform. These changes collectively improve user efficiency by streamlining approval processes, reducing manual data re-entry, and enabling role-specific views, while the infrastructure work positions Compliance Review and SALT for reliable production operation.
